race.comment: QUICKZOU (10) gets the nod second-up after resuming with a close fourth at Doomben when respected near the top of betting. Saluted over this track and trip to get off the mark last prep when leading pillar-to-post. Blinkers go on first time and he gets some weight relief. Bold showing anticipated. BAT OUT OF HELL (1) is the class runner easing in company, with a close Gold Coast trial suggesting he is ready to improve sharply on his Canterbury failure. DUOMO (2) also resumes and should inject some speed. Has trialled well and gets a key booking in Thompson. Have to take seriously. DYAMI (7) has been highly consistent, with recent placings at Ipswich and Doomben, including finishing ahead of QUICKZOU at Doomben. The knock is that he has had a few chances now without being able to get the job done.
